photoRights: Reference photography remains its owners' material. Not committed, packed into Blender, used as photographic textures or shipped in GLBs. Original geometry, seeded procedural finishes and reconstructed vector marks only. Steiner identifies the depicted subject, not endorsement.

dimensions.authority: Manufacturer's nominal envelope, not a measured scan or CAD
dimensions.note: The manual's rounded centimetre equivalents (5.3 x 3.3 x 3.0) are not additional precision. Local shapes, mounting plane and emitter position are photo-inferred art datums.

limitations: Visual-review candidate, not final human AAA acceptance or manufacturer CAD.
No calibrated end-on, underside or teardown reference. Hidden internals, exact rail tolerances and battery threads are not reconstructed.
Body relief, boot curvature, pad diamond depth, small fasteners and typography are photo approximations, not certified dimensions.
SOCKET_mount and SOCKET_laser are explicit but provisional art datums; actual seating and clearance require weapon-by-weapon integration checks.
Manufacturer documents mount-up operation. This asset does not establish unrestricted side/top mounting or compatibility with every weapon rail.
Recessed window uses an opaque coated-surface PBR approximation; no real laser optics, transmitted beam or emission is baked into the asset.
No flashlight changes, beam/dot rendering, switches, zeroing, AI effects, weapon-stat changes, shop integration or runtime attachment logic.
